design_summary: Buffered UART packet engine with a memory-mapped register interface, 16x8 TX and RX FIFOs, baud tick generation, UART transmit/receive state machines, packet counting, latched interrupt/status handling, and optional loopback support under a single synthesizable top-level block.

fixed_assumptions: Single synchronous clock domain driven by clk.
reset_n is an active-low synchronous reset unless implementation uses safe synchronous deassertion protection.
UART baud timing is derived from BAUD_DIV and clk.
RX and TX FIFOs are logically independent 16-entry structures with 8-bit payloads.
Packet completion is measured on valid byte counts, not framing bits.
Loopback routes transmitted valid bytes into the receive path only when enabled by CONTROL.LOOPBACK.
IRQ is level-driven from latched IRQ_STATUS bits gated by CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE.

top_module.name: uart_packet_engine
top_module.description: Top-level packet engine with integrated MMIO register block, baud generator, UART serializer/deserializer, FIFO control, packet counters, status/IRQ logic, and loopback routing.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete UART packet engine and memory-mapped register contract. The top block accepts register bus write/read strobes, decodes the register map, manages TX FIFO push operations via TX_DATA writes, manages RX FIFO pop operations via RX_DATA reads, generates baud ticks from BAUD_DIV, serializes outgoing UART bytes with 1 start bit, 8 data bits, no parity, and 1 stop bit, samples incoming UART frames, validates framing, detects overflow/underflow, tracks packet progress, and exposes status/interrupt outputs. Control registers configure enable bits, RX/TX enable, loopback, IRQ enable, baud divider, and expected packet length. STATUS and IRQ_STATUS are maintained as live and latched indicators respectively. The top-level also owns the debug packet counter visible through DEBUG_COUNT and the packet_count output.
responsibilities: Decode all MMIO accesses on wr_en/rd_en with wr_addr/rd_addr.
Implement CONTROL, BAUD_DIV, PACKET_LEN, TX_DATA push, RX_DATA pop, STATUS, IRQ_STATUS, IRQ_CLEAR, and DEBUG_COUNT semantics.
Generate a baud tick from BAUD_DIV for both RX and TX timing.
Maintain TX FIFO and RX FIFO occupancy levels and full/empty detection.
Serialize TX bytes into UART waveforms and deserialize UART RX waveforms into bytes.
Support LOOPBACK mode by redirecting transmitted valid bytes into the RX acceptance path.
Latch error and completion conditions until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR.
Assert irq only when IRQ_ENABLE is set and at least one IRQ_STATUS bit is set.
Drive externally visible status outputs and packet_count consistently with internal counters.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset_n asserted low, clear CONTROL, BAUD_DIV, PACKET_LEN, all FIFO storage and pointers, all FIFO count/level state, baud divider counters, RX/TX bit and byte state machines, shifters, packet counters, live status flags, IRQ_STATUS latches, irq output, and rd_data. uart_tx shall return to the idle high state after reset. rx_fifo_level, tx_fifo_level, and packet_count shall read as zero immediately after reset completes.
behavior_rules: CONTROL bits are: bit0 ENABLE, bit1 RX_ENABLE, bit2 TX_ENABLE, bit3 LOOPBACK, bit4 IRQ_ENABLE; unused bits read as zero and write as reserved-zero unless otherwise specified.
BAUD_DIV is a 16-bit divider value; a value of zero shall be treated as minimum-division behavior while remaining synthesizable and deterministic.
PACKET_LEN defines the number of valid bytes required for packet_done, rx_done, and tx_done qualification.
TX_DATA writes push one byte into the TX FIFO when the FIFO is not full; writes when full must latch tx_overflow and set error.
RX_DATA reads pop one byte from the RX FIFO when not empty; reads when empty must latch tx_underflow and set error.
STATUS reflects live conditions: tx_empty, tx_full, rx_empty, rx_full, tx_busy, rx_busy, packet_active, error.
IRQ_STATUS latches rx_done, tx_done, rx_overflow, tx_underflow, framing_error, and packet_done until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR write-one-to-clear semantics.
packet_count increments on each received valid byte accepted into the RX packet accounting path and is exposed on DEBUG_COUNT and packet_count.
LOOPBACK, when enabled, routes completed transmitted bytes into the RX acceptance path without creating combinational feedback on uart_tx.
The design must remain synthesizable without inferred latches and must use explicit state machines for UART TX and RX.
UART TX must generate one start bit, 8 data bits LSB-first, and one stop bit, with no parity.
UART RX must detect start/stop framing, reconstruct bytes, and reject framing-invalid characters.
Overflow and underflow conditions must be detected and latched in IRQ_STATUS and reflected in STATUS.error.
IRQ_CLEAR must clear only the bits written as 1 and leave all other latched bits unchanged.
rd_data must return zero or register-defined values for unmapped addresses, without side effects beyond the specified read semantics.
packet_done, rx_done, and tx_done shall be generated according to PACKET_LEN and the respective packet completion path.
All widths, counters, and state machines must be implemented in a way that supports the requested ~150-200 flip-flop scale with FIFOs, counters, shifters, state machines, and status registers.

register_contract.name: CONTROL
register_contract.description: Controls overall packet engine operation and feature enables.

register_contract.name: BAUD_DIV
register_contract.description: Baud rate divider for the UART timing generator.

register_contract.name: PACKET_LEN
register_contract.description: Expected number of valid bytes in a packet.

register_contract.name: TX_DATA

fields.name: tx_byte
fields.description: Byte to push into TX FIFO.

register_contract.description: Write-only FIFO push interface for transmit data.

register_contract.name: RX_DATA
register_contract.description: Read-only FIFO pop interface for received data.

fields.description: Sticky or live error indication as defined by implementation.

register_contract.description: Write-one-to-clear register for latched interrupt status bits.
